entries.title: 1992: NASA launches the Mars Observer. Eleven months later, the probe would fail while preparing for orbital insertion.
entries.summary: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the United States' civil space program, as well as research in aeronautics and space.

entries.title: 2018: Bill Cosby is sentenced to three to ten years in prison for aggravated sexual assault.
